entities.name: Gianluca Naso
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gianluca Naso is an Italian retired professional tennis player. He won three doubles titles on ATP Challenger Tour in Genoa and Todi. Both times his partner was Walter Trusendi. And in 2013 at Meknes with Alessandro Giannessi.
